relations.title: Adquisición de evidencia falible y emparejada
xSeil quantum formulation. Companion paper
relations.reading: Oracle definitions, resource estimates and demonstrated results should carry separate evidence labels rather than sharing a single quantum-performance claim.

relations.title: xSeil 2016 to 2018 Provenance Delivery and Code Evidence
relations.reading: Several articles may interpret the same deployment evidence; their shared provenance should remain visible rather than being counted as independent deployments.

relations.title: Research Portfolio
relations.reading: Each portfolio capability should link to evidence with its maturity stated explicitly: historical deployment, reconstruction, design, test or hypothesis.

relations.title: 01K-A01 — Human Capacity / HID Component Verification Record v0.1
relations.reading: The component verification record is useful technical evidence when its same-author scope and unresolved independent-validation obligations remain attached.

relations.title: G-02 — Independent Q-audit evidence, not a Boolean declaration
relations.reading: An audited-Q claim becomes testable when audit observations, fallibility, scope and cost are explicit, rather than supplied as a favorable Boolean flag.
